title: WireMessage
description:
Schema root covering each top-level wire shape without an extra wire wrapper.

Endpoints should decode their concrete type, such as `Request<Command>` or
`Response<QueryResult>`. This union is for schema export and inspection.

BackendReceipt.description:
Durable coordination receipt, not Evo acceptance, order or completion.

Issued only after the request and its forwarding/retry record are durable.
`received_at` is the original receipt time even when this receipt is replayed.

retry_until.description:
Inclusive minimum retention of the original receipt/result; at least the
request's first-receipt deadline. Later unknown retries fail closed.

Command.description: Coordination operations, with runtime input routing explicitly identified.

oneOf.description:
Create/update workspace metadata, including repository attachments or adoption.
The chain and existing identities are immutable across updates.
Invite, update or revoke workspace members.
Register/update directory metadata; never a claim that a runtime started.
Publish or detach workspace resource bindings.
Issue or revoke one independently scoped resource grant.
Acquire, renew or release Control ownership.
Route unchanged attributed input to Evo; coordination returns receipt only.

CommandResult.description: Distinct acknowledgement stages; no variant infers runtime success.

oneOf.description: Input was durably received for routing only.
Metadata mutation and its notification events were durably committed.
Control mutation committed; the returned lease still needs live fencing.

ownership.description: Resulting ownership state, including the epoch high watermark.

CommitReceipt.description: Metadata committed atomically with its retained events and deduplication result.

receipt.description: Original mutation identity and receipt retention guarantee.

through.description:
Boundary containing the mutation's events. Recover through it before
advancing a local cursor; this receipt alone cannot update the local view.

Completion.description: Terminal runtime result; completion is not implied by receipt or ordering.

oneOf.description: Runtime confirmed successful processing.
Runtime confirmed failed processing, possibly after partial execution.
Runtime confirmed cancellation, possibly after partial execution.

ComputeHost.description: A host's publication in this workspace; other workspaces need separate bindings.

owner.description: Owner/provisioning contributor, distinct from connected users.

ComputePermission.description: Host permission checked by Evo at the corresponding execution boundary.

oneOf.description: Establish a host connection without permission to execute operations.
Read files within the runtime's permitted sandbox.
Write files within the runtime's permitted sandbox.
Start or control permitted processes.
Install and serve local models on the host.

ConnectionRoute.description:
Discovery reference resolved through an authenticated transport adapter.

This carries neither credentials nor a cloud-specific tunnel/relay type.

protocol.description: Adapter protocol identifier, negotiated by consumers.

reference.description: Opaque, non-secret lookup reference; not a bearer capability.

Contributor.description: Public contributor directory entry, scoped by the enclosing workspace.

display_name.description: Presentation label, never an authorization key.

identities.description: Verified identity links visible to the requesting audience.

ContributorId.description: Actual human or service contributor; distinct from a session or host owner.

ContributorIdentity.description:
Attribution resolved by an authenticated adapter, not proof of authentication.

A receiving authority MUST verify these fields against the authenticated
connection. Forwarders preserve the contributor instead of substituting the
session owner, host owner or relay's service identity.

authenticated_as.description: Verified identity used for this submission; no token material.

contributor_id.description: Contributor to whom this request is attributed.

ControlCommand.description: Atomic ownership mutations; all are retried with the original request key.

oneOf.description: Acquire only if no unexpired lease exists and the watermark still matches.

expected_epoch.description: Last observed epoch; a successful acquisition assigns a strictly greater one.

lease_duration_ms.description: Requested positive lease duration, bounded by provider policy.

oneOf.description: Extend the current unexpired lease without changing its epoch.

fence.description: Exact current ownership; stale holders cannot renew.

lease_duration_ms.description: Requested positive extension, bounded by provider policy.

oneOf.description: Release only the matching current owner; retain the epoch high watermark.

ControlEpoch.description: Monotonic fencing epoch; zero means ownership has never been assigned.

ControlFence.description:
Fencing identity carried on every Control action and Control state write.

Not a bearer credential. Authorities must authenticate the holder and validate
current ownership at execution/append time, including on open connections.

epoch.description: Current ownership epoch, greater than zero.

ControlHolder.description: Exact runtime authorized to act as the workspace's Control runtime.

ControlLease.description: Authority-issued lease; renewal retains its epoch, reacquisition increases it.

expires_at.description: Authority-clock exclusive validity boundary; expiry alone grants no successor.

ControlOwnership.description: Durable ownership state, retaining the high watermark even while unassigned.

last_epoch.description: Never decreases or resets on release, restart or coordination adoption.

lease.description: At most one current lease, whose epoch equals `last_epoch`.

workspace_id.description: Workspace scope of both the watermark and any lease.

ControlValidation.description: Authority-clock validation result; advisory until rechecked at the write/action boundary.

oneOf.description: Holder, workspace, epoch and expiry matched at validation time.

checked_at.description: Authority time at which validation was performed.

lease.description: Validated lease, including its exclusive expiry.

oneOf.description: Missing, expired or superseded ownership; no execution/write is authorized.

checked_at.description: Authority time at which validation was performed.

CoordinationMode.description: Coordination mode and its repository attachments.

oneOf.description: OSS coordination for exactly one repository, without managed sign-in.
Managed metadata for zero or more attached repositories.

repositories.description: Repositories whose history is bound to this workspace's chain.

Delivery.description: Runtime-assigned delivery facts; a backend receipt has none of these fields.

accepted_at.description: Time Evo durably accepted the input.

order.description: Session-wide total input order, stable on replay and across restarts.

ordered_at.description: Time Evo durably assigned the order.

ErrorCode.description: Machine-readable error reason. Unknown codes require protocol negotiation.

oneOf.description: Invalid payload, identity binding or domain invariant.
Unsupported wire version.
Operation unavailable from this provider/runtime.
Missing or invalid authenticated connection.
Current membership, grant or policy forbids this action.

Current entity state conflicts with the proposed action.
Optimistic metadata precondition failed.
Fencing owner/epoch/expiry no longer authorizes this action.
Same deduplication key was used for different semantic content.
First-receipt deadline elapsed or the old result is no longer retained.
Cursor belongs to a different workspace/audience or is ahead of the stream.
Temporary provider or runtime unavailability.
Bounded capacity requires waiting before retry.

Event.description: Versioned retained event; live delivery may duplicate, delay or reorder it.

body.description: Full entity state or explicit removal at this position.

causation.description: Originating mutation when known; absent for unsolicited health/state changes.

cursor.description: Scope and durable order assigned by coordination, not runtime input order.

produced_at.description: Original producer time, retained even for late delivery/import.

recorded_at.description: Time the coordination authority durably recorded the event.

EventBody.description: Retained event body. Metadata revisions and runtime revisions have different owners.

oneOf.description: Workspace metadata/bindings committed by the coordination authority.
Contributor identity links or display metadata changed.

Recovery.description: Catch-up outcome; unavailable history is never represented as an empty success.

oneOf.description: Retained ordered events, possibly an empty current page.
Fetch a fresh snapshot before replacing the old view/cursor.

RecoveryCursor.description:
Recovery position in a workspace, audience and stream generation.

Positions are ordered only inside the same scope. A provider change, retention
reset or visibility change may require a new stream generation and snapshot.
Timestamps are not cursors. Event positions may contain gaps after filtering.

contributor_id.description: Authenticated audience; a cursor is not transferable to another contributor.

position.description: Exclusive resume position: ask for events strictly after this position.

stream_id.description: Authority-issued generation of this audience's visibility scope.

workspace_id.description: Workspace whose retained events are addressed.

RecoverySnapshot.description:
Atomic authorized directory view at an exclusive catch-up boundary.

Every listed metadata value reflects `as_of`. Runtime states are the last
confirmed facts recorded by that boundary, not proof a detached host stopped.
A snapshot replaces the prior scoped view; absent entities are removed.

as_of.description: Resume retained delivery strictly after this consistent boundary.

control.description: Durable Control ownership and epoch high watermark.

inputs.description: Last retained runtime-confirmed input states visible to this audience.

models.description: Published models available for authorized discovery.

Repository.description: Repository metadata; a repository may be attached to multiple workspaces.

id.description: Stable repository identity, independent of checkout paths.

remote.description: Credential-free canonical Git locator, if published.

RepositoryId.description: Repository identity, reusable across workspace attachments.

Request.description:
Request envelope shared by standalone adapters, managed adapters and Evo.

Mutations with the same key and semantic content replay the original durable
result. Changed content under that key is an idempotency conflict. Queries use
the key for correlation but may observe newer state when repeated.

context.description: Authenticated attribution, retry identity and first-receipt deadline.

control_fence.description:
Required for side effects originating from Control, including state writes.
This is validated against current ownership, not merely deserialized.

Request2.description:
Request envelope shared by standalone adapters, managed adapters and Evo.

Mutations with the same key and semantic content replay the original durable
result. Changed content under that key is an idempotency conflict. Queries use
the key for correlation but may observe newer state when repeated.

context.description: Authenticated attribution, retry identity and first-receipt deadline.

control_fence.description:
Required for side effects originating from Control, including state writes.
This is validated against current ownership, not merely deserialized.

RequestContext.description: Request correlation and attribution, unchanged across retries and forwarding.

contributor.description: Authenticated contributor, independent of resource ownership.

expires_at.description:
Deadline for first coordination receipt, using the authority's clock.
Receipt before this deadline permits later runtime delivery and execution.

request_id.description: Caller-generated identity created before the first submission.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to which all payload references are bound.

RequestId.description: Caller-generated retry identity; reuse only for the same logical request.

RequestKey.description:
Complete deduplication key, shared by coordination and runtime adapters.

A key covers all mutation kinds, not just one endpoint. Changing the payload,
deadline or authenticated subject under an existing key is a conflict.

request_id.description: Stable identity of the logical mutation, retained on every retry.

RequestStatus.description: Recoverable mutation result, without implying absence means safe re-execution.

oneOf.description: Retained original coordination result.
No retained result is available. This is not proof that execution never ran.

ResetReason.description: Why the old cursor can no longer safely recover the current view.

oneOf.description: Retained events before the cursor are no longer available.
Provider/stream generation changed, including managed adoption.
Current grants require a new authorized view and subscription scope.

ResourceCommand.description: Register/update publications or remove a workspace binding only.

oneOf.description: Register or update a compute host publication.
Register or update a provider publication.
Publish model capabilities/health from an authenticated runtime/provider.
Detach from this workspace without deleting the shared resource elsewhere.

ResourceRef.description: Exact resource binding being addressed; never an implicit global lookup.

oneOf.description: Compute host binding.
Provider binding.
Model publication binding.

Response.description: Response envelope; correlation never implies that execution succeeded.

result.description: Explicit success payload or protocol failure.

Response2.description: Response envelope; correlation never implies that execution succeeded.

result.description: Explicit success payload or protocol failure.

result.description: Explicit success payload or protocol failure.

RetryAdvice.description: How to recover from failure without creating a second logical mutation.

oneOf.description: This request must not be resubmitted automatically.
Retry unchanged, retaining the original key and deadline.

not_before.description: Earliest authority-clock retry time, if supplied.

oneOf.description: Outcome is uncertain; reconcile by the original key before taking action.

Revision.description: Metadata revision assigned by the coordination authority.

Role.description: Workspace metadata role; no role implicitly grants compute or model use.

oneOf.description: Workspace owner, subject to the provider's ownership policy.
Membership and configuration administrator.
Workspace participant.
Read-only workspace observer.

RuntimeBinding.description: Current routing binding; moving the runtime does not create a new session.

runtime_id.description: Runtime authorized to report this session's input state.

RuntimeId.description: Runtime instance identity authenticated by its host adapter.

RuntimeInputState.description:
Runtime-authored input lifecycle, never inferred from transport delivery.

Accepted input may later be ordered, run and complete. Rejection happens before
acceptance. Observers may miss intermediate states and use `InputRevision` to
discard delayed updates; terminal states cannot revert. Order is not a promise
of execution success or of completion order.

oneOf.description: Evo declined the input; no delivery order has been assigned.

error.description: Explicit rejection reason, including revoked access or stale fencing.

oneOf.description: Evo durably accepted the attributed input but has not reported order.
Evo durably assigned a unique position among this session's inputs.
Evo confirmed processing has started.
Evo confirmed a terminal outcome, including failure or cancellation.

RuntimeInputUpdate.description: Recoverable runtime fact. Relays preserve attribution, revision and order.

revision.description: Monotonic revision for this input, independent of event cursor positions.

runtime_id.description: Authenticated runtime producing this fact, matching the session binding.

state.description: Full confirmed input state at this revision.

RuntimeReport.description: Direct runtime report; relays may retain it as an `InputUpdated` event.

produced_at.description: Original producer time, preserved by relays.

update.description: Authenticated runtime fact; the transport authenticates its runtime ID.

workspace_id.description: Exact workspace scope, matching the input request and session binding.

RuntimeSubmission.description:
Direct or forwarded runtime submission, retaining the original request context.

Forwarders extract the unchanged `SubmitInput` body from the coordination
command. Evo deduplicates its semantic input, context and fence using the same
request key. Recipients must authenticate the delegation channel before
trusting a forwarded receipt, and its key must match `context.key()`.

body.description: Exact input originally submitted by this contributor.

context.description: Original contributor, retry key and first-receipt deadline, unchanged.

control_fence.description: Original Control fencing, when applicable; revalidated by Evo.

coordination_receipt.description:
Durable coordination receipt for forwarded input. Direct input uses `None`
and applies the first-receipt deadline at Evo itself. Never a bearer token.

Session.description: Directory metadata; registration is not runtime creation or execution success.

id.description: Reconnectable identity, preserved across coordination adoption.

owner.description: Owner who may share the session, never substituted for an input author.

parent.description: Optional parent session, preserving subagent relationships.

SessionId.description: Reconnectable session identity, preserved across provider changes.

SessionKind.description: Session purpose, independent of ownership and individual contributors.

oneOf.description: Ordinary human-directed or autonomous runner.
Ambient Control session; execution also requires current ownership fencing.

SessionPermission.description: Permission within an existing session; none permit host file/process access.

oneOf.description: Observe the authorized session's runtime history and state.
Submit attributed input to the runtime.
Manage session participation, subject to workspace policy.

StreamId.description: Recovery stream generation, changed after resets or visibility changes.

SubmitInput.description: Attributed text input. Identity and retry key live in the request envelope.

session_id.description: Target existing session in the request's workspace.

text.description: Exact submitted text, preserved across forwarding and retries.

Timestamp.description: Milliseconds since the Unix epoch; clocks do not define event/input ordering.

Workspace.description:
One workspace binds to exactly one logical chain.

Changing coordination mode preserves workspace, chain, repository and session
identities. The engine receives only `chain`, never this metadata object.

id.description: Workspace identity; must match the request/event scope.

WorkspaceId.description: Stable logical workspace identity, preserved when adopting managed coordination.

WriteCondition.description: Required precondition for a metadata write; there is no blind overwrite.

oneOf.description: Create only if the entity has never existed in this scope.
Replace only the stated current revision.
